notes: Ludum Dare 34 Compo narrative/stats game Cultivate (playable page linked from README: http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-34/?action=preview&uid=28426). Complete Unity 5.3.0f4 project (pre-package-manager; no Packages/manifest). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2015 Kyle Travis; git blob d4ddf5dd2f29b9fcbc96141e3dfb03c68793d544). Playable scenes enabled in the Unity 5.3 binary EditorBuildSettings: Assets/Menu.unity and Assets/Main.unity. No TextMesh Pro / EmojiOne / DOTween / Standard Assets / Asset Store / Library / Logs / DLL. Solo 48h Compo; no music (README: author did not have time to add/create music). Short original UI SFX retained under the repository MIT: choose.wav (md5 44790b5813c6cbbd1efbbc3031ff409d), hit.wav (16ccf51ce0977bdab6dd59000eb673a3), no-choose.wav (e726531e69166f6eb0a5801793b3db11), stat-down.wav (f8fe9dee916b9cee49cb41795e025ce1), stat-up.wav (61a65f33e9b3605389f08152a8869032), static.wav (ed8905146cc2876e4ce7f44b0acc6e19), step.wav (8b20f5dbedda00c31b196a12d819a5f6). Title image title.png md5 04124bd51c06f55aad3e7692d85230db. Assets/runescape_uf.ttf (RuneScape UF Regular, FontStruct / nayfan 2010, Version 1.0, md5 4c8754090a7936fac2f8c5f3043db9ee) and its .meta were omitted: the README incorrectly calls the font Public Domain, but the font name table licenses it as Creative Commons Attribution-No Derivatives (CC BY-ND 3.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/3.0/), which is not on the redistributable whitelist; it is also a RuneScape replica face. GUID refs may remain in scenes. Root index.html is a leftover Unity WebGL loader pointing at a Release/ build that is not in the repository and was kept as in upstream. ~1.1M src snapshot after the font omission. Claim #4148.
